transcript: The court was silent The prosecutor rose and began to lay out The details of the case methodically The defendant was at the scene On the day of the crime, this is definite from the testimony of several witnesses The defense attorney rose and argued back What seems apparent is not always the truth We have new evidence that will prove the defendants alibi On the witness stand, a young woman was trembling She was the person who had provided several clues to the police Her testimony was crucial That night I saw the defendant run from the scene She answered in a voice close to a whisper It was still too early for the judge to hand down his judgment Weeks later, the jury reached a verdict guilty The defendant was sent to jail But the attorney decided to appeal Law must be strict, but it must not lose room for mercy The pursuit of justice is always also a confrontation with the limits of human judgment

segments.text: The court was silent The prosecutor rose and began to lay out
The details of the case methodically The defendant was at the scene
On the day of the crime, this is definite from the testimony of several witnesses
The defense attorney rose and argued back
What seems apparent is not always the truth
We have new evidence that will prove the defendants alibi
On the witness stand, a young woman was trembling
She was the person who had provided several clues to the police
That night I saw the defendant run from the scene
She answered in a voice close to a whisper
It was still too early for the judge to hand down his judgment
Weeks later, the jury reached a verdict guilty
The defendant was sent to jail
But the attorney decided to appeal
Law must be strict, but it must not lose room for mercy
The pursuit of justice is always also a confrontation with the limits of human judgment
